facts.assertion: Havering states that it adopted its current Local Plan in 2021.
Havering identifies Reviewing and collecting evidence as the current stage of its Local Plan update.
Havering identifies Draft Local Plan consultation, also called Regulation 18, as the next stage after current evidence review.
Havering says the Inspector requested an immediate review after adoption to reflect national and regional policy changes and identify sites suitable for new homes.
Havering explains that Local Plan policies require evidence and go through examination before adoption.
Havering Council resolved on 17 November 2021 to adopt the Havering Local Plan 2016-2031.
The 17 November 2021 resolution included the Inspector's main modifications and the Council's minor modifications.
The 2021 adoption resolution retained Site Specific Allocations while revoking the Romford Area Action Plan otherwise from 29 December 2021.
Havering's Local Development Scheme states the Havering Local Plan 2016-2031 was adopted in November 2021.
Havering's Local Development Scheme states the Local Plan 2016-2031 does not include Site Specific Allocations.
Havering's Local Development Scheme states the Site Specific Allocations DPD 2008 is retained until replaced.
Havering's Local Development Scheme states site allocations in the Romford Area Action Plan 2008 are retained until replaced.
The Havering Cabinet adoption decision recorded recommendations to adopt the Local Plan 2016-2031.
The Havering Cabinet adoption decision recorded that Site Specific Allocations were excluded from the Romford Area Action Plan revocation.
Havering's 2025 Cabinet decision adopted Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Plans for Romford, Rainham and Gidea Park.
The Gidea Park Conservation Area decision is a heritage-management decision, not a Site Specific Allocation decision.
The current update being at evidence-review stage is distinct from the already adopted 2021 development plan.
A retained 2008 site-allocation policy remains a planning designation only where its actual boundary applies; its existence does not prove candidate intersection.
Havering's current-plan update is not yet at Regulation 18 according to the published timeline.
For candidate row 46142, no positive allocation membership is asserted from plan stage, retained-document status or heritage-plan context without polygon intersection evidence.
